verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs say Fluid compute runs server-side code on demand and scales concurrency. That is first-party evidence of automatic, load-driven scaling. The evidence is a single short marketing line, with no explanation of how scaling reacts to load or how large a burst it can absorb. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling behaviour and triggers, burst capacity and concurrency limits, cold-start handling under spikes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of absorbing large traffic bursts.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: Run server-side code on demand with Fluid compute, which scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads.
Vercel is a cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling web applications and AI workloads.
